findings.message: Only part of the 'one day per stat' class is fixed. The counts now use each person's own day `D`. But the year window start (`monthStart(y, 0)`), the `months` labels, the quarter `q`, and PeoplePage's `nextMonthName(today)` and `Q` label all still come from a single `day`: the latest today across every legal entity. On the whole-company view, whenever entities are on different dates across a month or year boundary, the labels and windows don't match the counts. Example: the window is `joined_on between <Jan 1 of the max day's year> and <the person's own today>`, so for people in an entity still in the old year the window is empty. Fix: derive every window and label from the same per-person day. Use `date_trunc('year', D)` as each person's window start and bucket by month relative to D. Either word the lede relatively ('next month') or work out one screen day per entity and only name a month when every shown entity shares it.
findings.scenario: Fixture tenant with Sri Lanka (UTC+5:30) and Australia (UTC+11), whole-company People at 2026-12-31T14:00Z. Australia is 2027-01-01 and Sri Lanka is 2026-12-31, so day=2027-01-01 and y=2027. The flows for Sri Lanka people become `joined_on between 2027-01-01 and 2026-12-31`, so all their 2026 joiners and leavers disappear. The chart shows only 'Jan' and the ticket reads 'Joiners and leavers, Q1'. Second case at 2026-11-30T14:00Z: the lede says contracts 'end in January', but a Sri Lanka fixed-term contract ending 2026-12-20 is counted in that number.

findings.message: The stats variant test covers only probation due this month and December joiners, for one Sri Lanka person. Round 2 explicitly asked for contracts ending next month and the joiners/leavers quarter to be covered too, and neither is. There is also no variant with two entities on different dates, which is the case the new max-day `day` and per-person `D` can disagree on. Fix: add table rows for `contractsEndingNextMonth` (a fixed-term contract ending in January at 2026-11-30T20:00Z), for `quarter`/`leavers`, and for a mixed Sri Lanka + Australia tenant at a time when the two entities fall in different months or years. Check both the counts and the rendered PeoplePage lede and quarter label.
findings.scenario: Revert `month(1)`/`month(2)` in the contracts-ending subquery to the old UTC `monthStart(y, m + 1)` and the whole suite stays green. Ship the year-window mismatch above and the suite stays green.

findings.message: With no `asOf` and no legal entity rows, `max(...)` is NULL, so `day` becomes the string 'null'. `new Date('nullT00:00:00Z')` is then invalid, and `monthStart(NaN, 0)` throws a RangeError from `toISOString`. The People screen and the `people_stats` MCP tool fail with an unrelated error. Before this round they fell back to UTC's date. Fix: when the day can't be worked out, return an explicit empty or 'no entities' result, or raise a clear error.
